title: Plan set docs_url without checking cross-epic API convention conflicts
description: Plan for Epic 2 set docs_url='/docs' on all FastAPI app instances, but Epic 1 (Infrastructure Foundation) owns API conventions and may disable /docs in production. The plan didn't check if the main.py files were in the epic_dag file_ownership_map or if another epic had conflicting API convention decisions. This created a potential conflict where two epics would set contradictory docs_url values.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic doesn't cross-reference epic_dag interfaces_provided/interfaces_consumed and file_ownership_map when generating API documentation plans. It assumed sole ownership of FastAPI app metadata without checking if another epic's scope covers the same concern.
recommendation: When generating TECH-6 (API Documentation) or similar cross-cutting plans, plan_phase_epic should: (1) check which epics provide 'API convention' interfaces, (2) verify that the files being modified (main.py) are in this epic's file_ownership_map, (3) if not owned, use conditional patterns (e.g., docs_url=... if settings.debug else None) and document the coordination requirement.
affected_section: Implementation Approach generation — specifically when handling API documentation and cross-cutting configuration concerns.

plan_sections_involved: Implementation Approach — TECH-6: API Documentation Standards

plan_context: Phase 1 Epic 2 — Tech Stack Standards, Python/FastAPI backend
